Name: Accelerace
Industrial segment: Tech, Deep Tech, Life Science, Climate
Quick info: Early to growth stage startups. 6-month programme  equity-free stipend. Multiple cohorts/year. Has supported 750+ startups since 2008.

Name: Bio Innovation Institute (BII)
Criteria: Life science & deep tech start-ups & researchers
Industrial segment: Biotech, Health, Deep Tech, Quantum Tech
Funding Amount: Up to EUR 1.8M/start-up and up to EUR 3M/project
Quick info: Life science & deep tech start-ups & researchers. Programmes  Bio Studio (academic researchers), Venture Lab (incorporated start-ups), BII Quantum Lab (quantum tech). DKK 5.5B funding from Novo Nordisk Foundation for 2026–2035.

Name: Climate-KIC Urban Mobility Food
Criteria: EU-based urban mobility or food systems startups

Name: Defence Tech Denmark
Criteria: DK-based defense or security tech startups

Name: DSV Group Innovation Partnerships
Criteria: Logistics automation, sustainability in freight, supply chain digitalisation
Quick info: Logistics automation, sustainability in freight, supply chain digitalisation. In-kind access to DSV’s global infrastructure.

Name: EIC Accelerator
Industrial segment: Deep Tech, Health, Cleantech, Chemistry, Physics, Quantum Tech, Materials Science
Deadline: 6 batching dates/year (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov)
Quick info: Single SME/startup, TRL 6–8. 6 batching dates/year (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov). Grant-only support available once per company under Horizon Europe.

Name: EIC Pathfinder
Industrial segment: Deep Tech, Health, Cleantech, Chemistry, Physics, Quantum Tech, Materials Science
Quick info: Research consortia, TRL 1–4. 2026  Pathfinder Open (12 May), Pathfinder Challenges (28 Oct). Total budget  EUR 262M. Success rate  ~2.1% (2025).

Name: EIC Transition
Criteria: Must build on EIC Pathfinder, ERC PoC, or Horizon Europe Pillar II project
Industrial segment: Deep Tech, Health, Cleantech, Chemistry, Physics, Quantum Tech, Materials Science
Quick info: Must build on EIC Pathfinder, ERC PoC, or Horizon Europe Pillar II project. Predecessor project must have been active for at least 18 months before cut-off. Single deadline  16 Sept 2026.

Name: EUDP
Quick info: Green energy R&D, companies & universities. 2025 funding  DKK 543M. Two calls/year (spring, autumn).

Name: Eurostars
Quick info: SME-led, international consortium (2+ Eurostars countries). Success rate  ~25–30%. IFD funds Danish participants up to EUR 500K if multiple Danish partners.

Name: Game Hub
Criteria: DK-based gaming or interactive media startups

Name: Global Entrepreneurship Programme (GEP)
Criteria: Growth-stage companies with US/Asia market ambitions
Quick info: Growth-stage companies with US/Asia market ambitions. 4–6 week in-market immersion periods. Operated with EIFO and Trade Council of Denmark.

Name: HeyFunding Legatet
Criteria: DK-based startups; focus on social impact

Name: Horizon Europe
Industrial segment: Tech, Health, Biotech, Cleantech, Sustainability, Chemistry, Physics, Quantum Tech, Materials Science

Name: IFD Grand Solutions
Industrial segment: Tech, Health, Biotech, Cleantech, Sustainability, General
Quick info: SMEs 35–75%, large companies 25–65%, research institutions up to 90% + overhead). Conditions  Consortia including companies & research institutions. Must address significant societal challenges or economic opportunities. Theme-based calls  March  open call  June.

Name: IFD Innobooster
Criteria: Danish SMEs with CVR number; must have raised DKK 100K or have DKK 250K gross profit
Quick info: Danish SMEs with CVR number  must have raised DKK 100K or have DKK 250K gross profit. Eligible costs  salaries, external knowledge providers, equipment, materials. Excluded  operational optimisation, rent, transport, sales/marketing. Often used as prolonged founding of previous innofounder grant winners.

Name: IFD Innoexplorer
Quick info: Public researchers, pre-CVR. Assessment criteria  novelty and commercial potential, applicant qualifications, and feasibility of the plan. Process  UCPH operates an internal Expression of Interest (EoI) process  researchers submit to an internal Lighthouse panel before full application. Reapplicants must also submit an EoI.

Name: IFD Innofounder
Criteria: Higher-ed graduates, early startup; full-time commitment mandatory
Quick info: Higher-ed graduates, early startup  full-time commitment mandatory. Non-EU/EEA applicants must hold a Start-up Denmark visa or have studied/worked in Denmark for at least one year. Grant treated as personal income for tax purposes. Can apply without a CVR, but CVR need to be created before project start.

Name: LEO Innovation Lab
Criteria: Start-ups and academic spin-outs in dermatology, digital health, medical devices
Quick info: Start-ups and academic spin-outs in dermatology, digital health, medical devices. Access to LEO Pharma labs and patient registries.

Name: Lundbeck Frontier
Criteria: Academic teams working on early-stage neuroscience discoveries
Quick info: Academic teams working on early-stage neuroscience discoveries (psychiatry, neurodegeneration, CNS drug discovery). Preserves researcher’s publication rights and university’s IP ownership.

Name: MUDP
Quick info: Environmental tech, companies & universities. 2025 allocation  DKK 135M. Annual call.

Name: NNF Distinguished Innovator Grant
Criteria: Senior Nordic researchers; proven track record
Quick info: Senior Nordic researchers  proven track record (previous innovation projects, patents, spin-outs). Must act as an ambassador for innovation within academia. Duration  3 years.

Name: NNF Pioneer Innovator Grant
Criteria: Nordic researchers; pre-CVR; health or sustainability focus
Quick info: Nordic researchers  pre-CVR  health or sustainability focus (cardiometabolic/infectious diseases, agriculture, food, industrial/environmental biotech, carbon capture, quantum tech). Combined annual budget  DKK 190M. Grant awarded to the institution, not the individual.

Name: Novo Nordisk External Research and Open Innovation
Criteria: Academic spin-outs and start-ups in obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, etc.
Quick info: Academic spin-outs and start-ups in obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, cell therapy, etc. Option-to-licence deals may include upfront + milestone payments.

Name: Novo Nordisk Foundation Fellowship Program Biomedical Design
Criteria: DK-based PhD students; biomedical design focus

Name: Open Discovery Innovation Network (ODIN)
Criteria: Precompetitive university-industry collaboration in drug discovery and diagnostics
Quick info: Precompetitive university-industry collaboration in drug discovery and diagnostics. Results are openly shared and not patented. DKK 54.5M pilot + DKK 14M from Lundbeck Foundation.

Name: Open Entrepreneur (Åben Iværksætter)
Criteria: PhD students and employed researchers at Danish universities
Quick info: PhD students and employed researchers at Danish universities. Allows up to 2 years leave with right to return. Combinable with Innofounder and Innobooster.

Name: Patent og Varemærkestyrelsen
Criteria: DK-based entities; must apply for patent or trademark

Name: Soundtech
Criteria: DK-based audio or music tech startups

Name: SPARK Denmark
Criteria: Health/life science projects with clinical or commercial potential
Funding Amount: Up to 700,000 DKK (350,000 DKK per year)
Quick info: 2x12-month structured mentoring programme; funds for for activities like proof-of-concept studies, consultants, prototyping only.

Name: Spin-outs Denmark
Quick info: Early-career researchers (postdocs) at one of the eight Danish universities. Applications must be endorsed by the department and include both a written application and an oral pitch. 82 grants awarded.

Name: Symbion / Copenhagen Science City
Quick info: Deep tech, digital, health startups. Symbion’s BioHub offers wet lab space at subsidised rates.

Name: The Gate
Quick info: Postdoc-to-entrepreneur transitions. Lighter-touch support network  complementary to Spin-outs Denmark.

Name: UCPH Proof of Concept Fund (POC MAX)
Industrial segment: Tech, Health, Biotech, Cleantech, Sustainability, General
Quick info: UCPH researchers  larger initiative. Duration  12–18 months  funds must be spent within the project period.

Name: UCPH Proof of Concept Fund (POC-TO-GO)
Criteria: UCPH researchers & PhD students; must have commercial or societal potential
Industrial segment: Tech, Health, Biotech, Cleantech, Sustainability, General
Quick info: UCPH researchers & PhD students  must have commercial or societal potential. Supported activities  prototype development, IP assessment, market validation, feasibility studies.

Name: Villum Foundation and VELUX Group
Criteria: Sustainable building technology, daylight research, indoor climate, biophilic design
Quick info: Sustainable building technology, daylight research, indoor climate, biophilic design. VELUX contribution qualifies as co-financing for Innobooster or EUDP.
